newsitem.title: USA: FTC seeks Office Depot -Staples merger data.
newsitem.headline: FTC seeks Office Depot -Staples merger data.

text.p: Office Depot Inc and Staples Inc said on Friday the Federal Trade Commission has requested additional information about the merger between the two companies.

The FTC's request about the proposed stock swap merger that would form an office supplies company with $10 billion in revenues will extend the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act, the companies said in a joint statement.
Office Depot and Staples said they plan to respond promptly to the request.
Office Depot holders would receive 1.14 Staples shares for each Office Depot share, the companies said on September 4, 1996, when the deal was announced.
